items.question: What percentage was the Education Cost Index set at for Dubai's for-profit private schools in the 2025-26 academic year?
items.fact: Dubai Education Cost Index 2.35% for 2025-26 academic year

items.question: Under the UAE Ministry of Education's 2016 resolution on private school registration, are UAE nationals allowed to register and fund private schools with a 'very weak' ranking?
items.gold: No, the resolution prohibits UAE nationals from registering and funding private schools with a 'very weak' ranking.
items.fact: UAE nationals barred from 'very weak' ranked private schools since 2016
